description: Mid- to long-term capacity planning for a reliable power system in Kenya - Data and models is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Pietro Lubello, Ariane Millot (University College London). This repository contains the data and models used for the study "Mid- to long-term capacity planning for a reliable power system in Kenya". Coverage: national (KE); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
